DellOperationPrivilege.description: Dell OEM extension for OperationPrivilege with payload matching.
DellOperationPrivilege.longDescription: This type provides Dell OEM extension for OperationPrivilege with payload-based privilege matching rules.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

PayloadMatchRules.description: Rules for matching request payload properties to determine privilege requirements.
PayloadMatchRules.longDescription: This property shall contain rules for matching request payload properties. An empty object indicates a default entry that matches any payload not caught by specific rules. Non-empty rules apply only if all specified conditions match (AND logic).

MatchCriteria.description: Matching criteria for a single payload property.
MatchCriteria.longDescription: This type shall contain the matching criteria for a single payload property. Exactly one match operator should be specified.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

ExactMatch.description: Matches if the payload property value exactly equals this value.
ExactMatch.longDescription: This property shall contain the exact value to match against the payload property. The match succeeds if the payload property value equals this value.

Exists.description: Matches based on whether the payload property exists.
Exists.longDescription: If true, the match succeeds if the payload property exists (regardless of value). If false, the match succeeds if the payload property does not exist.

GreaterThan.description: Matches if the payload property value is greater than this number.
GreaterThan.longDescription: This property shall contain a number. The match succeeds if the payload property value is greater than this number.

GreaterThanOrEqual.description: Matches if the payload property value is greater than or equal to this number.
GreaterThanOrEqual.longDescription: This property shall contain a number. The match succeeds if the payload property value is greater than or equal to this number.

InRange.description: Matches if the payload property value is within the specified range [min, max].
InRange.longDescription: This property shall contain a two-element array [min, max]. The match succeeds if the payload property value is a number within this inclusive range.

IsNull.description: Matches based on whether the payload property value is null.
IsNull.longDescription: If true, the match succeeds if the payload property value is null. If false, the match succeeds if the payload property value is not null.

LessThan.description: Matches if the payload property value is less than this number.
LessThan.longDescription: This property shall contain a number. The match succeeds if the payload property value is less than this number.

LessThanOrEqual.description: Matches if the payload property value is less than or equal to this number.
LessThanOrEqual.longDescription: This property shall contain a number. The match succeeds if the payload property value is less than or equal to this number.

NavigationUriOneOf.description: Matches if the payload property value matches any of the specified Redfish URI templates.
NavigationUriOneOf.longDescription: This property shall contain an array of Redfish URI templates in OpenAPI format (e.g., '/redfish/v1/Managers/{ManagerId}/NetworkProtocol/HTTPS/Certificates/{CertificateId}'). The match succeeds if the payload property value matches any of the URI patterns in the array.

OneOf.description: Matches if the payload property value equals any value in this array.
OneOf.longDescription: This property shall contain an array of allowed values. The match succeeds if the payload property value equals any value in this array.

RegexMatch.description: Matches if the payload property value matches this regular expression pattern.
RegexMatch.longDescription: This property shall contain a regular expression pattern. The match succeeds if the payload property value (converted to string) matches this pattern.

PayloadMatchRules.description: A set of payload property matching rules.
PayloadMatchRules.longDescription: This type shall contain payload property matching rules. Each property name in this object corresponds to a property in the action request payload, and its value specifies the matching criteria. An empty object indicates a default entry that matches any payload.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.
